rules.sentence: However, a true pulmonary trunk and confluent pulmonary arteries distinguish typical pulmonary atresia from cases predominantly characterized by MAPCAs.

rules.disease: Tetralogy of Fallot with Absent Pulmonary Valve
rules.sentence: This TOF variant features the absence or severe underdevelopment of the pulmonary valve, leading to pulmonary regurgitation and aneurysmal dilation of the pulmonary arteries.
